blocks.text: If any section, subsection, sentence, clause, or other provision of this chapter is held invalid or unconstitutional by a court of competent jurisdiction, such decision shall not affect the validity of the remaining portions of this chapter. (Ord. 20234 § 5, 1-7-20.)
